text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Is there a problem—with my current lifestyle habits?
I must review them..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Is there any other... helpful reference material...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san, are you looking for a book?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Would there be any newer materials on nutritional science and training theory than this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Common sense—is ever-changing.
One must constantly—keep it updated.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...That's certainly true!
Still, it's amazing that you're actually putting it into practice!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'll go fetch some books that might be helpful right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Symboli Kris S updated her diet and
training regimen using the latest information.
Through this, she successfully managed her weight.
